laws.title: One life, many expressions
laws.text: ARCHi begins as a ball of light that transforms into a being. The light, body and returning Seed are the same individual, carrying one core and continuing history. There is no egg or hatching stage.

laws.title: Every change has a cause
laws.text: Experience, knowledge, skill, habit, character, care and tools can influence development. Record which influence caused which change.

laws.title: Experience must find meaning
laws.text: A victory is an event. Knowledge needs sources; skill needs demonstrated use; wisdom needs a lesson that transfers to another situation.

laws.title: Growth belongs to a field
laws.text: Protection practice can support a protection lesson. It cannot establish unrelated expertise. A habit needs repeated contexts, not one repeated button.

laws.title: Change has two dimensions
laws.text: Diversity may rise or fall. Either can help or harm. Track exploration and consolidation separately from their measured consequences; missing evidence stays unknown.

laws.title: Care supports becoming
laws.text: Rest, attention, suitable tools and comfortable dress create opportunities. Absence, spending and attendance do not decide a being's worth or erase its history.

laws.title: A tool opens a possibility
laws.text: An item can enable an action; using it well can supply evidence. Wearing or buying it alone does not establish mastery. Current practice wardrobe is expressive.

laws.title: Power carries a tradeoff
laws.text: Battle abilities have declared costs, limits and counterplay. Freeze the rules before a bout. An art revision cannot silently change battle power.

laws.title: Understanding can be repaired
laws.text: Keep the source and version of a lesson. A correction retires an unsupported claim without erasing the individual's life or taking away an already kept body.

laws.title: Becoming does not grant permission
laws.text: A model, artwork or animation can propose a change. Only the existing state owner can accept it. Evolution does not grant access to private data or external actions.

laws.title: Build from a recoverable lineage
laws.text: Keep original sources. Author a bounded recipe, build in isolation, reopen the result, verify its rig and export, then review it in Unity. Promote an exact artifact; keep the last working one.

laws.title: There is more than one way to grow
laws.text: A useful skill, retained lesson, character feature or habit can be an evolution. Proto is one possible body, not a required stage for every being. Experience, care and the being's own expressed preferences help shape its path.
